title: Battle of Girolata
text: The Battle of Girolata was a naval action fought on 15 June 1540 in the Gulf of Girolata, on the west coast of the island of Corsica, amidst a war between Charles V and the Ottoman sultan Suleiman the Magnificent. An Ottoman squadron of 11 galleys, anchored at Girolata, under the command of the Ottoman admiral Dragut, was surprised and defeated by 21 galleys led by the Genoese Gianettino Doria and the Spaniard Berenguer de Requesens.
